component.name: Smart DND
component.summary: Automated Do Not Disturb based on schedules and calendar events

description.p: Smart DND automatically enables Do Not Disturb (DND) mode on a schedule or during matching calendar events.

ul.li: Automated schedule windows with midnight wrapping
Calendar event keyword and regex pattern matching
Buffer offsets to start DND early or extend after meetings
Pluggable architecture for calendar backends, notification systems, and frontends
Native Libadwaita interface with system tray integration

screenshot.caption: Recurring schedules, including windows that run past midnight
Calendar rules that match event titles, with buffers before and after
Choose your notification system, calendar backend and start at login
Tray menu in the Caelestia shell: toggle DND and see what's next

description.p: The first release of Smart DND for Linux.

Smart DND turns on Do Not Disturb for you: on a regular schedule, such as weeknights, or during meetings and other events in your calendar. It turns it off again when they end, and it never overrides a change you make yourself.
